svg.title: Open-Meteo's RRFS and its default model minus KPMV's reports, Sep 25, 2026 to Nov 22, 2026
svg.desc: Histograms of forecast minus reported wind speed, gust and direction for Open-Meteo's archived 10 m wind from the RRFS model asked by name and from its default model over the same hours. Hours counted per bin; the dashed line is zero. Bars right of zero are blue (forecast above the report), left of it magenta (below), the zero bar grey (nearer zero than half a bin, on neither side).
svg.text: Open-Meteo's RRFS and its default model minus KPMV's reports, Sep 25, 2026 to Nov 22, 2026
Hours per bin. Right of the dashed line the forecast was above the report, left of it below.
Row pairs: the RRFS by name, then the default model over the same hours; the start of each run, then a day earlier.
forecast above the report (right of the line)
nearer zero than half a bin (neither)

Open-Meteo rows: weather data by Open-Meteo.com, CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0), reworked as differences from KPMV’s reports.
Speeds rounded to whole knots, as a METAR reports. Direction only where the report gave one (not calm or variable). Source: docs/rrfs-comparison-plan.md, scripts/windErrorsData.ts.
